topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I handled things just right. When I found out about the lies, I could've made a scene, lashed out. But I didn't. Instead, I pulled my friend aside, kept my voice calm, and asked them why they felt the need to lie about their job. It was important to me that they saw this wasn't about me losing my temper but about us being honest with each other. I listened to their side, too. It wasn't easy, but I kept my cool, and I think that really made a difference. They opened up, and we've come out stronger for it.
